title: Onboard to Velocity: Tooling, Role Activation, and Early-Career Ops Checklist
author: Maya Ortiz
content:
Overview

Purpose: This playbook is a concise, operational checklist and toolkit for managers, onboarding buddies, and new contributors to enable fast, safe, and auditable access to Redwood’s core systems. It focuses on the first 90 days with specific, measurable handoffs and recovery steps for tooling and access problems.

Scope: Applies to full-time employees, long-term contractors (>90 days), and internal transfers. Does not replace team-specific training or security-sensitive provisioning workflows documented under Security & Compliance.

Owner and escalation

- Owner: People Ops (onboarding infrastructure lead)
- Primary contact: Maya Ortiz (people-ops-onboarding@redwood.ai)
- Access escalation (SRE/security): Eng-SRE Pager (pager duty) and security-ops@redwood.ai
- Typical SLA targets: 95% of standard access granted within 24 hours, 99% of critical access within 72 hours for non-restricted roles.

Quick start (one-line):

1) New hire fills pre-join form -> 2) People Ops triggers provisioning -> 3) Manager verifies app access -> 4) Buddy confirms toolflow and first-week checkpoints.

Before day 0 (pre-join checklist)

- Confirm candidate role and level in HRIS with hiring manager (title, region, compensation band).
- Send the pre-onboarding form that includes preferred laptop, home-city for depot shipping, OS preferences, and primary time-zone.
- Determine required security clearance: standard, elevated, or restricted. If elevated/restricted, trigger security review (target timeline: additional 3–10 business days).
- Provision initial accounts in identity provider (Okta) with a temporary activation email scheduled for start date.
- Reserve onboarding buddy and schedule an initial 30-minute sync on day 1.

Day 0–7: tool access and first-week flow (manager + buddy responsibilities)

Manager responsibilities (first 48 hours):
1. Confirm role-specific repo/team ownership in SourceControl (gitlab/github) and add to team group.
2. Add new hire to Slack channels: #team, #product, #eng-all (or team-specific equivalents).
3. Schedule first-week 1:1 cadence (30 minutes daily stand or check-in as appropriate).
4. Verify access to core productivity tools (Gmail, Calendar, Drive) and Redwood Console demo account.

Buddy responsibilities (day 0–7):
- Run through first-boot checklist and observe account sign-ins.
- Walk through developer local workflow and minimal reproducible example of developer loop (clone -> build -> run-test).
- Confirm access to the following with evidence (screenshot or quick confirmation message in Slack):
  - Git service (read + clone)
  - Internal docs Confluence (view + comment)
  - CI status dashboard (view)
  - Helm/infra repos (view) if required by role
  - Redwood Console demo project (view / run sample request)

Week 2–4: role activation and deeper tooling

- Assign primary code reviewer and on-call mentor where applicable.
- Add to per-product service groups for routing and oncall (if role requires).
- Grant write access to repos and deployment pipelines only after a documented code review and small PRs have been merged.
- Schedule first 30/60/90 goal-setting meeting and align on meaningful 30-day deliverable.

Role-to-tool access matrix (critical mapping)

- This table is the canonical quick reference the manager and people-ops should use when requesting provisioning. Values are role archetypes, not exhaustive.

| Role archetype | Minimum access (Day 1) | Elevated access (Day 7–30) | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| IC Engineer (Backend) | Okta, Git (read), CI dashboard, Slack, Confluence | Git write, Deployment CI runner, Infra read | Infra access gated by infra PR review and owner approval |
| IC Engineer (Frontend) | Okta, Git (read), CDN dashboard, Slack, Confluence | Git write, Staging deploy access | Staging-only deploys for first 30 days |
| ML Engineer | Okta, Git (read), Model registry (view), Data access request form | Model registry write, dataset s3 access (scoped) | Data accession requires dataset steward approval |
| Product Manager | Okta, Confluence (edit), Jira, Slack | Analytics dashboards, feature flags (view) | Feature flag toggles require two-step approval for shipping windows |
| Security/SRE | Okta, PagerDuty (view), Runbooks | Infra admin, Audit log access | Must complete 2FA via hardware token before admin access |

Tool provisioning templates and common CLI commands

- Gitlab: Add to group with role "developer" via Admin Console (team ops flow). Example snippet used by People Ops: curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_TOKEN" "https://git.internal/api/v4/groups/<group_id>/members" -d "{\"user_id\":<id>,\"access_level\":30}"

- Okta: Use the onboarding automation playbook to create user and assign app groups. CLI: oktactl users create --email new@redwood.ai --display-name "Name" --groups engineering-oncall

- Redwood Console demo project: assign role "viewer" then incrementally promote to "developer" after first successful PR merge.

Access governance and audit expectations

- Every elevated access grant must include: requestor, approver (manager/owner), justification, and expiry (default 90 days if temporary).
- All admin-level grants must be recorded in the access-audit sheet and sent to security-ops@redwood.ai.
- People Ops runs a monthly access hygiene sweep; managers will be notified for removal/re-certification tasks.

Recovery and troubleshooting (common failures)

- Problem: New hire cannot access Okta activation link
  1. Confirm email entered correctly in HRIS and pre-join form.
 2. Re-send activation from Okta admin console.
 3. If link expired, revoke old activation and generate a new link.
 4. Escalate to identity-team@redwood.ai if link generation fails (target response: 4 business hours).

- Problem: Git clone 403 forbidden
 1. Confirm employee Git username in Okta and map exists in Git service.
 2. Verify group membership and token provisioning.
 3. If token not present, generate PAT via secure onboarding flow and rotate per token guidance.

Manager checklist (first 90 days) — sequential tasks

1. Day 0: Send welcome note, confirm buddy assignment.
2. Day 1: Verify minimal accesses (see Day 0–7).
3. Week 1: Confirm first small PR merged, run retrospective with buddy.
4. Week 2: Approve role-specific elevated access requests if milestones met.
5. Day 30: Performance check and development plan; mark access needs for next 90 days.
6. Day 90: Complete closeout evaluation and finalize long-term access grants.

Security & compliance callouts

- For roles touching customer data or production inference telemetry, follow the data-residency and access-justification templates. These require a signed data handling attestation (see security-and-compliance/data-management).
- Hardware tokens (FIDO2) are required for all SRE and security team members before admin privileges are issued.

Templates and artifacts to attach (links)

- New-hire pre-join form: /docs/onboarding/pre-join-form
- Access request template: /docs/onboarding/access-request-template.yaml
- Role justification checklist: /docs/people-ops/role-justification.md

Metrics and KPIs we track

- Time-to-first-signin (target: <8 hours after start)
- Time-to-minimal-access (target: 24 hours)
- Percentage of hires with documented buddy meeting in first 7 days (target: 95%)
- Access rollover cleanups completed on schedule (target: monthly cadence, >98% compliance)

Appendix A — common access durations and recommended expiries

- Temporary contractor access: 30–90 days (set explicit expiry)
- Elevated infra access: 90 days (requires re-approval)
- Permanent product access (PM/Design): no expiry but annual review by manager

Appendix B — glossary

- People Ops: team responsible for lifecycle, provisioning queues, and onboarding tooling.
- Buddy: peer-level mentor assigned for first 30 days to accelerate ramp.
- Minimal reproducible example: smallest project that demonstrates local dev loop.

Related resources and next steps

- If you are a manager: use the Manager Onboarding Checklist macro (Confluence) to auto-populate the tasks above into your calendar.
- If you are a new hire: book a 15-minute session with People Ops using the "Onboarding Health Check" link in your welcome email.
